# CWP: scripted triggers from the base game's scripted_triggers, needed by the restored vanilla flavour events
# (the mod blanks the vanilla files of this folder). Generated by docs/maintenance/restore_flavour_events.py.

# from 00_ai_triggers.txt
ai_avoids_radicals = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			always = no
			divided_monarchists_ai_monarchist = yes
		}
	}
}

ai_wants_radicals = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			always = no
			divided_monarchists_ai_republican = yes
		}
	}
}

character_is_french_house = {
	OR = {
		always = no
		always = no
		always = no
	}
}

character_is_rival_french_house = {
	owner ?= { divided_monarchists_ai_backs_monarchist = yes }
	character_is_french_house = yes
	NOT = { character_matches_divided_monarchists_ai_path = yes }
}

character_matches_divided_monarchists_ai_path = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owner ?= { divided_monarchists_ai_backs_orleanist = yes }
			always = no
		}
		AND = {
			owner ?= { divided_monarchists_ai_backs_legitimist = yes }
			always = no
		}
		AND = {
			owner ?= { divided_monarchists_ai_backs_bonapartist = yes }
			always = no
		}
		AND = {
			owner ?= { divided_monarchists_ai_republican = yes }
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
			}
		}
	}
}

divided_monarchists_ai_backs_bonapartist = {
	divided_monarchists_ai_bonapartist = yes
	divided_monarchists_ai_house_hooks_active = yes
}

divided_monarchists_ai_backs_legitimist = {
	divided_monarchists_ai_legitimist = yes
	divided_monarchists_ai_house_hooks_active = yes
}

divided_monarchists_ai_backs_monarchist = {
	divided_monarchists_ai_monarchist = yes
	divided_monarchists_ai_house_hooks_active = yes
}

divided_monarchists_ai_backs_orleanist = {
	divided_monarchists_ai_orleanist = yes
	divided_monarchists_ai_house_hooks_active = yes
}

divided_monarchists_ai_bonapartist = {
	var:divided_monarchists_ai_var ?= flag:bonapartist
}

divided_monarchists_ai_house_hooks_active = {
	always = no
	NOT = { always = no }
}

divided_monarchists_ai_legitimist = {
	var:divided_monarchists_ai_var ?= flag:legitimist
}

divided_monarchists_ai_monarchist = { # Is the AI playing this content and not Republican?
	OR = {
		divided_monarchists_ai_orleanist = yes
		divided_monarchists_ai_legitimist = yes
		divided_monarchists_ai_bonapartist = yes
	}
}

divided_monarchists_ai_orleanist = {
	var:divided_monarchists_ai_var ?= flag:orleanist
}

divided_monarchists_ai_republican = {
	var:divided_monarchists_ai_var ?= flag:republican
}

# from 00_coa_triggers.txt
coa_republic_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
	}
}

# from 00_ep2_victoria_scripted_triggers.txt
character_is_valid_for_events = {
   NOT = { has_variable = golpista_var }
   is_adult = yes
}

country_has_isolationism_or_sakoku = {
    has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
}

# from 00_ip5_victoria_scripted_triggers.txt
civil_war_is_valid_for_reforms_at_gunpoint = {
	OR = {
		civil_war_is_liberal_revolution = yes
		civil_war_is_socialist_revolution = yes
	}
	civil_war_progress_high = yes
	political_movement = {
		exists = most_desired_law
		most_desired_law ?= {
			NOT = {
				is_same_law_group_as = law_type:law_council_republic
			}
		}
	}
}

# from 00_scripted_triggers.txt
has_hierarchic_ideology = {
	has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic
}

state_has_decree_variant = {
	has_decree = $DECREE$
}
